Documentation / Guides

Runtime dependencies

Gmac builds its native macOS application from this repository, downloads a pinned Wine gaming runtime (Libraries.tar.gz) during setup, optionally embeds a custom DirectX 12 bridge (gmacmetal), and consumes user-supplied Apple D3DMetal from Game Porting Toolkit. This document records the pinned versions, source repositories, SHA-256 digests, and update cadence so builds remain reproducible.

See ReleaseWorkflow.md for the release and runtime publication procedures, and .github/workflows/RuntimeTrack.yml for automated upstream drift tracking.

Runtime selection logic

At setup and update time (GmacWineDownloadView.swift and GmacWineInstaller.shouldUpdateGmacWine()), Gmac fetches DistributionConfig.versionPlistURL (https://frankea.github.io/Whisky/WhiskyWineVersion.plist). When the legacy channel version (3.1.1) is older than DistributionConfig.gamingRuntime.version (4.6.12), Gmac downloads DistributionConfig.gamingRuntimeURL instead and verifies the archive against DistributionConfig.gamingRuntime.sha256 before extraction. The installer fails closed on any SHA-256 mismatch.

Source and bundled translation layers

v4.6.12-gaming.1 is built from the winecx-gptk lane (CrossOver 26 changes on Wine 11.16) using runtime/local-build.rb with MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.0 and HAVE_PIPE2 left undefined so the Mac display driver (winemac.so) runs on macOS 15 and macOS 26 as well as newer releases.

Component Version or commit Source Notes
Wine / CrossOver (winecx) cea5139d87afca768e1d77d8f263492ae45172a3 rolling7ho/winecx (d3dmetal-errno branch) Wine 11.16 with CrossOver 26 changes, the Retina fix for hosted Metal layers, Steam Dock/menu/fullscreen fixes, and the ntdll errno stack fix for D3DMetal 4 worker threads.
DXMT 0.80 3Shain/dxmt Direct3D 11 and 10 to Metal. Last MIT-licensed release (v1.0 and later are LGPL; moving past 0.80 requires an explicit relicensing decision). Native d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll, and d3d10core.dll reside in Libraries/DXMT/{x64,x32} for per-bottle deployment, while builtin winemetal.dll and winemetal.so reside in the Wine library tree.
DXVK (macOS) 1.10.3 Gcenx/DXVK-macOS Frozen at 1.10.x by design. DXVK 2.x requires Vulkan 1.3 features that MoltenVK and macOS do not expose.
MoltenVK Bundled in the runtime lane KhronosGroup/MoltenVK Vulkan to Metal translation underpinning the DXVK path.
msync Included in winecx marzent/wine-msync Mach-based synchronization patch integrated into the Wine build.

User-supplied Apple D3DMetal (Game Porting Toolkit)

Apple D3DMetal is proprietary software owned by Apple and is never bundled in Libraries.tar.gz or committed to this repository. Users obtain the Game Porting Toolkit disk image directly from Apple Developer and import it through Gmac Settings › Graphics or the PC Graphics picker.

GPTKImporter verifies Apple's code signature on every binary and checks that external/ contains no unsealed items, stores the payload outside Libraries/ so it persists across runtime updates, and deploys it into Libraries/Wine/lib/ only when the installed Wine runtime is GPTK-capable. When D3DMetal is not deployed, GraphicsBackendResolver selects DXMT (or DXVK if DXMT is unavailable) for Automatic bottles.

Optional Gmac DirectX 12 layer (GmacD3D12)

Gmac includes support for a separate DirectX 12 to Metal bridge (gmacmetal) built from rolling7ho/dxmt (teardown branch). Because its unix-call bridge uses the gmacmetal name instead of winemetal, it sits beside the runtime's DirectX 11 DXMT payload without interfering with it.

scripts/build-gmac-d3d12.sh cross-compiles the 64-bit and 32-bit DLLs and unixlib from a sibling ../dxmt checkout (or $GMAC_DXMT_DIR) and stages them into build/gmac-d3d12/. scripts/install-local.sh embeds build/gmac-d3d12/ into Gmac.app/Contents/Resources/GmacD3D12/ when present.

Bundled inside the application

Several tools ship directly inside Gmac.app/Contents/Resources/ rather than inside Libraries.tar.gz, so updates reach users through normal application releases without a runtime download.

Resource Pinned version Repository path Notes
winetricks 20260125 Libraries/winetricks POSIX shell script (LGPL-2.1+) from Winetricks/winetricks. Copied by the "Embed GmacCmd" build phase and asserted by CI.
verbs.txt Generated from 20260125 Libraries/verbs.txt Verb catalog displayed in the Winetricks sheet. Regenerate after bumping winetricks with sh Libraries/winetricks list-all and remove the leading platform-warning line so the file starts at the first ===== header.
cabextract Prebuilt arm64 Mach-O Libraries/cabextract Extracts Microsoft .cab archives for winetricks verbs, from cabextract.org.uk. Code-signed on copy.
GmacDiscordBridge.exe Committed PE binary GmacKit/Sources/GmacKit/Discord/Resources/GmacDiscordBridge.exe Built from scripts/discord-bridge/bridge.c with mingw-w64. Relays the Discord RPC named pipe to the host macOS socket.
GmacAudioTest.exe Committed PE binary Gmac/Resources/GmacAudioTest.exe Built from scripts/gmac_audio_test.c via scripts/build_audio_test.sh. Used by audio troubleshooting probes.

Swift Package Manager dependencies declared in Gmac.xcodeproj and GmacKit/Package.swift:

  • Sparkle: application auto-updater.
  • SemanticVersion: version parsing and comparisons.
  • swift-argument-parser: command-line parsing for GmacCmd.
  • swift-docc-plugin: DocC documentation generation for GmacKit.

Legacy channel (v3.1.1) and archive integrity

Prior to the custom rolling7ho/winecx gaming runtime, the upstream fork channel published Libraries.tar.gz assemblies via scripts/assemble-runtime.sh and dist/pages/WhiskyWineVersion.plist. .github/workflows/RuntimeTrack.yml continues to track upstream Wine (Gcenx/macOS_Wine_builds 11.0_1), DXVK (Gcenx/DXVK-macOS v1.10.3-20230507-repack), and DXMT (3Shain/dxmt v0.80) weekly.

Libraries.tar.gz (v3.1.0) 86e2d54a60736f27e6ce82cacf2a91e500c20f6d32ae959a16afd912e6b03096
Libraries.tar.gz (v3.0.0) 9c3d2a7d9bb682ae8398d8bae458e3cb52bb9f5a3345fb0830a64d9b6a1025f8

When publishing any runtime release, compute the digest of the exact uploaded Libraries.tar.gz file with shasum -a 256 Libraries.tar.gz and update DistributionConfig.gamingRuntime (for gaming runtimes) or dist/pages/WhiskyWineVersion.plist (for legacy channel builds), together with this table.

Tracking cadence

  • Gaming runtime (rolling7ho/winecx and rolling7ho/dxmt): update manually when upstream CrossOver/Wine changes, Retina fixes, or D3DMetal compatibility fixes are needed. Rebuild via runtime/local-build.rb and verify with scripts/build-gmac-d3d12.sh.
  • Upstream Wine, DXVK-macOS, and DXMT feeds: .github/workflows/RuntimeTrack.yml polls these GitHub release feeds weekly and opens an issue if a pinned tag falls behind. Bumping any pin is a manual, tested decision.
  • D3DMetal (Game Porting Toolkit): Apple distributes GPTK without a GitHub release feed; monitor Apple's GPTK page manually for compatibility changes.
  • winetricks: releases approximately monthly and is bumped manually when a verb download URL breaks or a new dependency is required.
  • Security: critical Wine, DXVK, or DXMT vulnerabilities trigger an out-of-band runtime rebuild and application release per SECURITY.md.
